description: Na₂HPO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.63 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom.
